headline: Red Sox stumble at Fenway while the Celtics face a long offseason
morning_brew: Sunday afternoon at Fenway Park was a total grind that ended in another disappointing loss. A 3-1 final against the Astros in ten innings leaves this team at 13-21 and searching for any kind of identity. I don't care what the sabermetric guys say, you cannot win games when your starter only goes four innings. Jose Suarez put a massive burden on the bullpen and Zack Kelly just could not hold it together in the tenth. We are heading to Detroit now and the vibes are at an all-time low in the Hub.

The fallout from the collapse against Philadelphia is going to be felt all summer long. Blowing a three-one lead is something you just do not see from a team with this much talent. It is the kind of loss that makes you question the entire core of the roster. Philadelphia has been a thorn in our side since the Bird era, but losing like this in the modern day is just pathetic. Two days after the Bruins got bounced by Buffalo, the Celtics followed suit with their own disaster right here at the Garden.

Looking at the new class in Foxborough, the front office clearly focused on the trenches and depth. R1.28: Caleb Lomu, OT out of Utah. Drake Maye needed better protection all year. Love the pick, total necessity. R2.55: Gabe Jacas, EDGE out of Illinois. The defense needs a boost on the outside. A bit of a reach with other guys available. R3.95: Eli Raridon, TE out of Notre Dame. We needed another target in the passing game. Smart move to get more weapons. R5.171: Karon Prunty, CB out of Wake Forest, depth at corner. R6.196: Dametrious Crownover, OT out of Texas A&M, more protection for the pocket. R6.212: Namdi Obiazor, LB out of TCU, special teams or depth. R7.234: Behren Morton, QB out of Texas Tech, a developmental arm. R7.245: Jam Miller, RB out of Alabama, backfield depth. R7.247: Quintayvious Hutchins, EDGE out of Boston College, a local kid to round out the class.
